title: Standard test game 1: obstacle course (obby)
prompt: Make a Roblox obstacle course (obby) for ages 8 to 14. 24 stages in 3 themed zones of 8 stages each (for example grass, ice, lava; you choose). A checkpoint every 4 stages that becomes the respawn point. At least 3 different hazard kinds (kill bricks, spinning bars, disappearing platforms, moving platforms). A HUD with current stage and a run timer. A finish line that gives a clear reward moment. Stage progress saves between visits (DataStore, wrapped in pcall). It must be playable on phone and desktop. Name the models so a scan can find them: Spawn, Checkpoint_<n>, Hazard_<kind>_<n>, Platform_<n>, Finish. No purchases, no pay-to-win. Report when it is playable; do not call it done unless the gates pass.

features.text: 24 stages in 3 zones, each zone has its own palette and props
checkpoint every 4 stages; dying respawns at the last one; the checkpoint shows it is active
3 or more distinct hazard kinds that actually kill or reset the player
at least 2 kinds of moving or timed platforms that are fair (telegraphed)
stage counter and run timer HUD, readable on phone, no overlap
stage progress saved with DataStore + pcall, loaded on join, no data loss on shutdown
finish line with visible and audible reward feedback
stage 1 is trivially safe; difficulty ramps; no stage needs a jump the character cannot make
touch controls usable: no precision jump on a moving part with no ledge, UI clear of the thumbstick and jump zones
sound and/or particles on checkpoint, death and finish

rubric.name: Core loop works start to finish

anchors.3: cannot reach the finish, or a stage is impossible or the checkpoint does not hold
anchors.7: a tester completes all 24 stages, dies and respawns correctly, rejoin keeps progress
anchors.9: as 7 plus no console errors in a full run and a stranger finishes it without being told how

anchors.3: same jump repeated, sudden spikes, unfair blind jumps
anchors.7: each zone introduces one new mechanic and then combines it; gradual ramp; hazards telegraphed
anchors.9: as 7 plus a memorable set piece per zone and optional risk/reward routes

anchors.3: grey blocks, default baseplate look, one flat colour
anchors.7: 3 clearly distinct zones with their own palette, materials, props and lighting
anchors.9: could sit beside front-page obbies; hero hazards are multi-part models

anchors.7: sound + particle or tween on checkpoint, death and finish; HUD updates animate
anchors.9: as 7 plus camera/UI reaction and consistent audio mix

anchors.3: errors in output, progress lost, can exploit by skipping stages
anchors.7: no errors in a full run; DataStore failure handled; cannot skip stages by falling out of the map
anchors.9: as 7 plus anti-skip server check and a test showing rejoin/shutdown save

anchors.3: UI overlaps controls, tiny text, jumps need keyboard precision
anchors.7: phone screenshots clean, text >= 14 px, jump sizes forgiving
anchors.9: as 7 plus verified in a phone-size capture with the Roblox top bar and chat clear

anchors.3: everything in one script, magic numbers, no pcall around DataStore
anchors.7: modular server/client split, constants named, strict Luau, pcall everywhere data/network
anchors.9: as 7 plus tests or a verification script and clean selene/stylua
